odoo.connectionDesc: Read-only access to the Odoo HR employees. The API key is stored encrypted and never shown again.
odoo.keyMissing: SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set on the server, so the Odoo feature is disabled. Set it and restart the app (see the README).
odoo.apiKeySavedHint: API key saved. Leave empty to keep it.
odoo.apiKeyEmptyHint: Create a read-only API key in Odoo (Preferences > Account Security).

odoo.modeReviewDesc: Preview, tick the changes you want, then apply.
odoo.mappingDesc: Map the job title to a level. The first row whose pattern is contained in the title wins; otherwise the level is member.
odoo.syncDesc: Preview shows what would change. Nothing is written until you apply.
odoo.applyFullWarning: Full mode overwrites names, managers and levels of linked accounts with the Odoo values and disables accounts that are no longer active in Odoo. Admin accounts are never disabled.
odoo.dependsOnCreate: Depends on creating {name}; skipped while that account is not selected.
odoo.managerWillBeEmpty: {name} is not selected, so this account will be created without a manager.
odoo.skip_managerCycle: manager chain would form a loop
odoo.credentialsDesc: Shown only once. Share each password with its owner; they must change it at first sign-in.
odoo.pendingDesc: Passwords of accounts created by automatic syncs. They are deleted as soon as you view them.
odoo.credentialsLocked: Dismiss the temporary passwords first; they cannot be shown again.
